# A.0 What a witness is, and how to check one by hand
A witness is a triple (T, v, c): T a 5-connected sphere triangulation on n vertices (plantri 5.8, `plantri -a -c5 n`, graphs numbered in plantri's output order, vertices 0…n−1 in plantri's letter order), v a vertex of degree 5, c a proper 4-coloring of T−v listed on the vertices of T−v in increasing vertex order, canonical under colour relabeling (first colour seen = 0, second = 1, …). The claim recorded for each in-frame witness: c is STUCK (τ_v(c) = 6: all six colour pairs operationally tangled, Definition 5), and NO fully-legal word of the frozen 186-menu (5 roles × 3 pairs, ordered pairs of distinct pairs, applied as the four-stage commutator m₁m₂m₁m₂ with the canonical context re-derived at c) has an image with τ ≤ 5; some two-word sequence does. Every row below can be regenerated from (n, plantri index, v, coloring) and the definitions; the sha256 of the coloring list is printed for a cheap identity check.

# A.2 Legend for the per-witness fields
- **type_28**: the 8×8 0/1 intersection matrix of Kittell's eight link-seeded chains under the far-copy seed rule, upper triangle in the order θα θβ θε θγ θδ θζ θη αβ αε αγ αδ αζ αη βε βγ βδ βζ βη εγ εδ εζ εη γδ γζ γη δζ δη ζη; 22 bits are forced on every stuck coloring (Cal §822), six vary: αζ βη εζ εη γδ ζη.
- **far4**: (α∩ζ, β∩η, ε∩ζ, ε∩η) nonempty — the necessary condition T2595; **1111 on every witness**.
- **traj_core6**: 0/1 intersections among W_i's stage chains (X₁X₂, X₁X₃, X₁X₄, X₂X₃, X₂X₄, X₃X₄).
- **cut anatomy (5610/5623, W_i)**: |C| = |X₃ ∩ X₄|; C_dist_link (1 on every witness); ker(X₃−C) − 1 = extra kernel dimension; |K| = the near copy's component of X₃ − C; fence length; region sizes; distinct images of the 186-word family.
